name: Requester
description: Work-party supervisor. Requests permits for their crew and can cancel their own requests.

name: Area authority
description: Controls a site. Approves, rejects and closes permits at their sites.

name: HSE officer
description: Approves permit types that need HSE approval, records gas tests and can reject those permits.

name: Viewer
description: Read-only access to permits and their history, for example for an audit.
